title: Create Table [UNIQUE and AUTOINCREMENT]
description:
The two final most important keywords for tables are `UNIQUE` and `AUTOINCREMENT`.
`UNIQUE` is exactly what it sounds like. It makes the field unique, so it errors if you insert two of the same values into it. `AUTOINCREMENT` works on a number type, and will auto-increment by 1 to the newest possible one. You may now notice `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` is just `INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL AUTOINCREMENT` internally. You cannot use autoincrement on non integerprimarykeys.
# Assignment:
Make the instances table's id an auto-incrementing integer primary key, and make the name field unique.
